game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: anthonyjf85
quote: Unnecessary diagloge in the beginning and throughout the game, absolutely pointless activities they FORCE you to do. Why am I moving a couch? What does this have to do with GRAND THEFT AUTO?? Main protagonist voice is awful, who casted that guy? Why am I not allowed to carry every weapon? I do not need ULTRA realism. This is a video **** real life. This game, regardless of its size and graphics will go down as one of the worst games ever made which is understandable when you look at the developers.
